This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Design Technology specification.

Identifying Requirements appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Identifying Requirements in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Identifying Requirements.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
